scope: read-only comparison of existing source, historical artifacts, failed-replay evidence, logs, and provenance; no replay or training launched

data_scope.dataloader: DataLoader(batch_size=1, shuffle=True, num_workers=4, seed_worker, make_dataloader_generator(0)) in both audits
data_scope.preprocessing_and_local_mask_valid: dataset source and build_patch_targets source are unchanged from the historical audit source state
data_scope.remaining_data_limit: Neither historical provenance nor audit output records a content hash of the 2,162 input image/mask files.

raw_utility_semantics.valid_mask: build_patch_targets(mask, patch_count, local_mask_valid) expanded over groups in both sources
raw_utility_semantics.second_gain: second value of topk(gain_rel, 2) along factor dimension in both sources
raw_utility_semantics.source_comparison: No executable raw-utility semantic difference found.

historical_margin_formula.pre_filter: gain, target, and residual records are first boolean-indexed by valid
historical_margin_formula.formula: best = gain.max(-1); second = gain.topk(2, -1).values[:, 1]; margin_rel = (best - second) / max(abs(best), 1e-12); selected = best > 0 and margin_rel > 0.10

new_margin_formula.formula: valid and best > 0 and (best - second) / max(abs(best), 1e-12) > 0.10
new_margin_formula.equivalence: The new in-place valid predicate is exactly equivalent to the historical valid-patch prefilter; focused regression test proves identical eligible and winner counts.

failed_replay.first_evidence_divergence: The final combined-eligibility assertion failed, but the previous audit implementation raised before serializing the actual condition/winner counts. The first semantic layer that differs cannot be recovered from existing artifacts.

root_cause_classification.why_not_formula_mismatch: Historical and new executable formulas and all thresholds/floors match.
root_cause_classification.why_not_data_semantics_mismatch: Split, root, seed, ordering, dataset/preprocessing source, and local-valid source match; byte-level historical data provenance is absent.
root_cause_classification.why_not_raw_utility_mismatch_identified: The failed replay discarded the observed raw-condition and winner aggregates, and the historical audit persisted no raw gain vectors.

persist the compact audit payload before raising an invariant failure
